resources.scope: Each process separate: exact /proc kB maxima. Native full trace independently reaggregated; supervisor maxima/CPU are sampler-report only because no supervisor full trace was requested. No RSS+DRM or client-peak sums.

source_immutability_scope: Before-run snapshot, in-run result source pins, and post-run current files match; snapshots cannot prove no byte-for-byte-reverted intermediate mutation.

policy.scope: All native samples reported firmware/EPPperformance. Before/after daemon snapshots show power-saver with no holds; explicitly post-release sysfs snapshot shows low-power/EPPpower. Workload-finish conditions were captured before hold release. Snapshots do not prove exact continuous daemon history.

acceptance.parity_scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.
acceptance.active_cancel_scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.
acceptance.scope: synthetic saturated delivery, animated UI and independent silent audio; no stem playback/full deck or musical-quality claim
